entry.title: Queensland, Australia reaches the end of a severe heatwave warning for six northern districts, with Mount Isa forecast at 40 °C on the 5 November peak
entry.summary: Australia's Bureau of Meteorology warning ran from 3 to 6 November across the Peninsula, Gulf Country and four further districts. — Sources: Australian Bureau of Meteorology, Queensland heatwave warning, 3 November 2026 · ABC News, 2 November 2026, citing senior meteorologist Steve Hadley

entry.title: The Rhine at Kaub, Germany, read 19 centimetres on 6 November, still close to its early-November low
entry.summary: Germany's federal gauge network measured the Rhine at Kaub at 19 centimetres at 06:15 on 6 November, up from 17 centimetres on 5 November and well below the 61 centimetre peak of 28 October. — Sources: Wasserstraßen- und Schifffahrtsverwaltung, Pegelonline gauge network, reading of 6 November 2026
